declared_limitations: the reference host is arm64 and has no linux/amd64 Docker daemon, so the image was built once natively in the target's WSL2 Docker from a verified clean clone and never rebuilt. R46's save/transfer/load integrity check is therefore not applicable; exactness holds by identity instead, and the reference-versus-target semantic comparison is made between the canonical host environment and that image, which crosses both operating system and CPU architecture.

one earlier in-image full-suite invocation on target segfaulted at a pre-existing decentralized-runtime test. It did not reproduce in seven subsequent runs, including two complete full-suite runs at 4265/0. It is recorded rather than omitted.

the live qualification canary produced zero scientific GENERATION_INVALID replicas, so the invalidity semantics are established by the synthetic R13 matrix and by structural reuse of the frozen candidate producer rather than by an observed invalid rollout.

phase_closure_canonical_host.note: adds this phase's 51 qualification-record tests, which postdate the image and contain no runtime code

verdict_text: Probabilistic Recoverability V3 is implemented additively against all frozen contracts, including required-replica invalidity and no-early-abort semantics; loss, Brier and event weighting are exact; V1 and V2 remain unchanged; the exact implementation image reproduces reference semantics on the Windows target; no official V3 data have been generated.
